entry: 12:00 America/New_York; last hourly bar must have ended plus60seconds strictly before decision; only raw open at decision used as modeled entry, never same-bar HLC
features: completed prior days only; ATR14 arithmetic true-range mean; SMA50; median volume20; prior20 high excludes signal day
breakout: prior close above prior20 high, prior volume>=1.2*preceding20 median volume, prior close>SMA50; last known hour close above frozen level
gap: equity only; actual session open gap to prior close between0.5 and2ATR; open>prior close>SMA50; last known hour close>session open and prior high; crypto has no overnight equity session gap
retest: a qualifying breakout within last5 completed days; last known hourly low<=frozen breakout level+0.25ATR and close>level; frozen ATR and level from that breakout
entry_guards: price<=last known hourly close+0.25ATR; breakout/retest price<=level+1ATR; 2ATR/entry>=3*(roundtrip variable cost rate); reject unadjusted jumps>20% within61 prior days
ranking: (prior close-SMA50)/ATR, descending, then symbol; no learned score or label calibration
holding: planned24to72 elapsed UTC hours, choose valid session12:00 closest48hours; crypto48hours; account for holidays/half-days/DST; no admissible future session=>no entry; stops/targets may exit earlier

risk.capacity: 1percent median prior20 known hourly dollar volume

exit: native modeled stops at worse(open,stop) for long; stop-first if both stop/target touch in bar; conservative target fill exactly target; deadline at scheduled open; missing deadline bar blocks account, not silent skipping
accounting: continuous cash plus positions plus dividend receivables; dividends ex-date entitlement, payable-date cash; splits adjust qty and price levels; shared infrastructure once per UTC calendar day; no broker writes

validation.paired_uncertainty: daily log growth vs same-cost CASH, Bartlett HAC5 with IID floor, descriptive mean-3SE; not global search correction
